summary: A short biographical note on Giorgio Li Calzi, an Italian figure born in Turin in 1965. It records that he began overdubbing piano and synthesizer as a child and took up the trumpet in 1990.
one_line: Biographical note on Giorgio Li Calzi, a Turin-born musician who started overdubbing piano and synthesizer as a child and took up trumpet in 1990.
key_facts: Giorgio Li Calzi was born in Turin, Italy in 1965.
Giorgio Li Calzi started overdubbing piano and synthesizer as a child.
Giorgio Li Calzi began to play the trumpet in 1990.
